title: Rainwater at the Fire Station
transcript:
A fire station in Northbridge has begun using rainwater for part of its daily work. Two large tanks behind the building collect water from the roof. After passing through a simple filter, the water can be used to wash vehicles and clean the outdoor training area. These jobs previously used the same treated water that supplies local homes.

The idea came from a firefighter who noticed how much water ran into the street during a heavy shower. At first, the team hoped to use the collected water for every activity at the station. A technical check showed that this would require expensive treatment equipment. The project was therefore limited to tasks that do not need drinking water.

The tanks arrived in spring, but installation took longer than expected. Workers discovered an old cable beneath the planned foundation and had to move the tanks several metres. They are now beside the equipment store, where a small screen displays the amount of water remaining. When the tanks are nearly empty, staff can switch back to the normal supply.

The station will compare its water use with records from the same months last year. This matters because a wet winter alone could make the savings look greater than they really are. Local schools have been invited to visit the system, although the station has reminded teachers that operational duties may require a visit to be postponed.

questions.prompt: What is the collected rainwater used for?
options: Washing vehicles and cleaning the training area.
Replacing all the water used in local homes.
questions.answer: Washing vehicles and cleaning the training area.
questions.explanation: 过滤后的雨水用于清洗车辆及室外训练场，不用于饮用。

questions.prompt: Why was the original plan reduced in scope?
options: The roof was too small to collect any rain.
The team could not find a suitable filter.
Local residents objected to the tanks.
Treating water for every purpose would cost too much.
questions.answer: Treating water for every purpose would cost too much.
questions.explanation: 技术检查发现，全用途供水需要昂贵的处理设备，因此只保留非饮用用途。

questions.prompt: What delayed the installation of the tanks?
options: An old cable was found under the planned foundation.
The equipment store had to be rebuilt.
The tanks were delivered to a different town.
Schools requested a larger display screen.
questions.answer: An old cable was found under the planned foundation.
questions.explanation: 工人在预定地基下发现旧电缆，因此必须调整水箱位置。

questions.prompt: Why will staff compare records from the same months?
options: To decide when school holidays should begin.
To make the water saving comparison more meaningful.
To calculate the age of the fire station.
To find the cheapest supplier of water filters.
questions.answer: To make the water saving comparison more meaningful.
questions.explanation: 使用相同时段记录比较，有助于避免单纯因雨季差异而夸大节水效果。
